scope: Pinned source audit; not a live-account certification

findings.title: No final check of current entry location
findings.current_behavior: Validity uses completed bars; current bid/ask is recorded but never tested against the rejected extreme, trigger, signal age or extension.
findings.root_cause: Validity uses completed bars; current bid/ask is recorded but never tested against the rejected extreme, trigger, signal age or extension.
findings.expected_behavior: Store setup ID, sweep extreme/time, structural trigger/time and allowable execution zone. Immediately before submitting, fetch one fresh MqlTick, reject a reclaimed invalidation level, stale quote or stale trigger, and measure trigger-to-executable-price distance in ATR and spread. Require an explicitly configured maximum extension; initially test it in shadow mode rather than guessing a profitable threshold. An out-of-zone setup must wait for a separately confirmed retest or expire, never silently market-chase.
findings.trading_impact: A formerly valid reversal can be entered after the live quote has invalidated it or after the move has already traveled far. This can explain poor location; live attribution is unproven.
findings.fix_specification: Store setup ID, sweep extreme/time, structural trigger/time and allowable execution zone. Immediately before submitting, fetch one fresh MqlTick, reject a reclaimed invalidation level, stale quote or stale trigger, and measure trigger-to-executable-price distance in ATR and spread. Require an explicitly configured maximum extension; initially test it in shadow mode rather than guessing a profitable threshold. An out-of-zone setup must wait for a separately confirmed retest or expire, never silently market-chase.
findings.verification: With identical closed bars, permit an in-zone quote, reject a quote beyond invalidation and reject excessive favorable extension. Repeat after injected submission latency.
findings.evidence: Extracted Observe: quote 98, 102 (above extreme 101), and 90 all valid; score 95.3333 in synthetic fixture.

findings.title: Synchronous network work delays entries and basket management
findings.current_behavior: CloudSync runs before Manage; Start emits CAMPAIGN_START before OpenLayer. WebRequest blocks the EA thread with a 5000ms timeout per request.
findings.root_cause: CloudSync runs before Manage; Start emits CAMPAIGN_START before OpenLayer. WebRequest blocks the EA thread with a 5000ms timeout per request.
findings.expected_behavior: Remove remote calls from the pre-order and critical risk path. Queue immutable telemetry locally, service it outside the trading event thread through a separate transport component, or explicitly budget bounded transport windows while retaining broker-side protection. Process risk first, revalidate price after any blocking action, timestamp decision/submission/fill separately. Do not describe another event handler in the same EA as asynchronous.
findings.trading_impact: The nominal 250ms scan is not a 250ms protection guarantee. An event timeout can make an entry stale; heartbeat/config/ACK delays postpone virtual exits.
findings.fix_specification: Remove remote calls from the pre-order and critical risk path. Queue immutable telemetry locally, service it outside the trading event thread through a separate transport component, or explicitly budget bounded transport windows while retaining broker-side protection. Process risk first, revalidate price after any blocking action, timestamp decision/submission/fill separately. Do not describe another event handler in the same EA as asynchronous.
findings.verification: Inject heartbeat/config/event delays and outages; measure risk-loop gaps and decision-to-submit delay. Confirm current-price validation runs after any delay.
findings.evidence: Source ordering plus official MQL WebRequest/OnTimer semantics; no real network-latency broker replay performed.

findings.title: Frozen watch survives structural invalidation and blocks a new candidate
findings.current_behavior: A watch is cleared on elapsed expiry or Start; a newer extreme/reclaim does not invalidate it. Only one directional watch exists.
findings.root_cause: A watch is cleared on elapsed expiry or Start; a newer extreme/reclaim does not invalidate it. Only one directional watch exists.
findings.expected_behavior: Define explicit WATCHING, CONFIRMED, INVALIDATED, CONSUMED and EXPIRED states. Invalidate on structural reclaim/new extreme according to the selected reversal family; a genuinely new sweep gets a new ID and frozen reference values. Track setup age and trigger age separately, and expose cancellation reasons.
findings.trading_impact: Obsolete setup remains eligible up to 12 minutes and can suppress a better/new opposite setup.
findings.fix_specification: Define explicit WATCHING, CONFIRMED, INVALIDATED, CONSUMED and EXPIRED states. Invalidate on structural reclaim/new extreme according to the selected reversal family; a genuinely new sweep gets a new ID and frozen reference values. Track setup age and trigger age separately, and expose cancellation reasons.
findings.verification: Arm sell watch, form new high, then opposite sweep; verify old candidate cannot execute and new candidate is evaluated without waiting for old timer.

findings.title: Same completed candle can authorize repeated additions
findings.current_behavior: Spacing and floating profit are enforced, but no trigger ID or consumed-bar guard exists.
findings.root_cause: Spacing and floating profit are enforced, but no trigger ID or consumed-bar guard exists.
findings.expected_behavior: Separate explicit batch execution from distinct signal-driven additions. Default to one confirmed add per setup/trigger ID; persist its consumed state. Additional batches require a documented cap and total risk/margin check, not a reusable candle flag.
findings.trading_impact: Exposure can grow repeatedly from one old confirmation. Videos sometimes show rapid batching, so this is a mismatch to the code’s fresh-confirmation rationale, not proof the trader always waits a candle.
findings.fix_specification: Separate explicit batch execution from distinct signal-driven additions. Default to one confirmed add per setup/trigger ID; persist its consumed state. Additional batches require a documented cap and total risk/margin check, not a reusable candle flag.
findings.verification: Feed two spaced quotes with unchanged M1 closed bars; signal-driven mode must open at most once. New confirmed trigger may allow the next add.
findings.evidence: Extracted AddSignal + Manage opened twice on signal bar time 9940.

findings.title: Add path has inconsistent structural and timeframe gates
findings.current_behavior: If Observe returns campDir, its invalid watch bypasses fallback. Manage ignores s.valid and accepts microBreak plus score. Fallback continuation/failed-pullback uses no M3/M5 filter.
findings.root_cause: If Observe returns campDir, its invalid watch bypasses fallback. Manage ignores s.valid and accepts microBreak plus score. Fallback continuation/failed-pullback uses no M3/M5 filter.
findings.expected_behavior: Return separate reversalCandidate and continuationCandidate results. Define mandatory conditions for each add family explicitly, select by campaign direction, and use a dedicated addEligible flag. Never infer eligibility from a direction match or reuse first-entry score for an invalid candidate.
findings.trading_impact: A same-direction watch can suppress a clean add, or its score can permit an add without the first-entry rejection/timeframe requirements.
findings.fix_specification: Return separate reversalCandidate and continuationCandidate results. Define mandatory conditions for each add family explicitly, select by campaign direction, and use a dedicated addEligible flag. Never infer eligibility from a direction match or reuse first-entry score for an invalid candidate.
findings.verification: Exercise same-dir invalid watch plus valid continuation, opposite watch, missing rejection, failed M3, and absent momentum; assert the intended family-specific result.

findings.title: Score threshold is largely redundant and one BOS branch is not a close break
findings.current_behavior: Default mandatory rejection + microBreak + M3 already contributes 25+24+22+8=79, above entryScore 76. Second BOS clause allows a low/high breach plus close beyond previous open, not necessarily beyond structure. Maximum theoretical score is 105 then clipped to 100.
findings.root_cause: Default mandatory rejection + microBreak + M3 already contributes 25+24+22+8=79, above entryScore 76. Second BOS clause allows a low/high breach plus close beyond previous open, not necessarily beyond structure. Maximum theoretical score is 105 then clipped to 100.
findings.expected_behavior: Specify whether confirmation requires a close beyond a particular swing or accepts an intrabar break with hold/retest. Encode the chosen predicate explicitly. Keep mandatory conditions outside ranking; remove constant/redundant score points or relabel score as an uncalibrated ranking. Calibrate weights only on held-out labeled examples.
findings.trading_impact: A high score is not calibrated confidence or evidence of a high-quality execution moment; a wick breach can satisfy the named structural confirmation.
findings.fix_specification: Specify whether confirmation requires a close beyond a particular swing or accepts an intrabar break with hold/retest. Encode the chosen predicate explicitly. Keep mandatory conditions outside ranking; remove constant/redundant score points or relabel score as an uncalibrated ranking. Calibrate weights only on held-out labeled examples.
findings.verification: Boundary fixtures where low breaks but close stays above prior low; enumerate score maxima/minima with each mandatory gate. No positive unrelated score may replace the intended structure rule.

findings.title: Optional timeframe data remains mandatory and context may predate setup
findings.current_behavior: M1, M3 and M5 Rates are always requested successfully before proceeding even when filters are disabled. M3/M5 use closed candle color, with no sweep-relative timestamp or regime context.
findings.root_cause: M1, M3 and M5 Rates are always requested successfully before proceeding even when filters are disabled. M3/M5 use closed candle color, with no sweep-relative timestamp or regime context.
findings.expected_behavior: Only request optional data when enabled. Name candle-color filters accurately. Log data readiness and timestamps; define whether context may predate sweep rather than silently using it as fresh confirmation. Evaluate requiring fresh M3 separately, since it can worsen entry lateness.
findings.trading_impact: A missing disabled timeframe silently blocks scanning; an old candle can confirm or delay a new reversal.
findings.fix_specification: Only request optional data when enabled. Name candle-color filters accurately. Log data readiness and timestamps; define whether context may predate sweep rather than silently using it as fresh confirmation. Evaluate requiring fresh M3 separately, since it can worsen entry lateness.
findings.verification: Disable M5 with missing M5 history: M1 scanner must still work. Test stale/pre-sweep M3 and opposite current M3 formation.
findings.evidence: Extracted Observe remains valid when M3 timestamp is before sweep; intended semantics need specification.

findings.title: Broker request success is treated as an executed trade or applied stop
findings.current_behavior: Uses CTrade Boolean result to advance layers, save SL state and emit success; no successful execution retcode/deal/position reconciliation.
findings.root_cause: Uses CTrade Boolean result to advance layers, save SL state and emit success; no successful execution retcode/deal/position reconciliation.
findings.expected_behavior: Classify ResultRetcode and actual fills; use deal/position identifiers and OnTradeTransaction reconciliation. Pending request, partial fill, successful fill and reject must be separate states. Update layer/fill/SL state only from verified broker facts. Verify actual position SL after modification; retry only idempotently with bounded backoff.
findings.trading_impact: Rejected or partial orders can corrupt campaign state. A refused break-even modification may be recorded as active and not retried.
findings.fix_specification: Classify ResultRetcode and actual fills; use deal/position identifiers and OnTradeTransaction reconciliation. Pending request, partial fill, successful fill and reject must be separate states. Update layer/fill/SL state only from verified broker facts. Verify actual position SL after modification; retry only idempotently with bounded backoff.
findings.verification: Broker adapter tests for true+rejection, partial fill, requote, delayed deal, invalid stops and failed modification. Native MT5 integration required.
findings.evidence: Source trace and official CTrade Buy/PositionModify documentation; no live broker failure induced.

findings.title: Minimum volume can exceed the requested margin budget
findings.current_behavior: NormVol clamps upward to minimum before v<mn is tested, making the insufficient-minimum-budget branch unreachable.
findings.root_cause: NormVol clamps upward to minimum before v<mn is tested, making the insufficient-minimum-budget branch unreachable.
findings.expected_behavior: Compute raw stepped volume without raising it to minimum. If it is below minimum, return zero unless independently calculated minimum margin fits the budget. Recalculate margin and perform OrderCheck on the final volume with a reserve. Derive precision from actual step, including .25 or .00125.
findings.trading_impact: A small probe can consume much more than the intended percentage; broker may reject it or fill an unexpectedly large relative exposure.
findings.fix_specification: Compute raw stepped volume without raising it to minimum. If it is below minimum, return zero unless independently calculated minimum margin fits the budget. Recalculate margin and perform OrderCheck on the final volume with a reserve. Derive precision from actual step, including .25 or .00125.
findings.verification: Budget 1.5, minimum-lot margin 10 must return zero; test valid min, .25 step, nondecimal step, insufficient margin and dynamic margin changes.
findings.evidence: Extracted function returned 0.1 lots needing 10 margin for a 1.5 budget.

findings.title: Failed basket closure still clears campaign state
findings.current_behavior: Master-gone, recovery-to-entry and master-SL branches ignore CloseAll result and call Finish even if positions remain.
findings.root_cause: Master-gone, recovery-to-entry and master-SL branches ignore CloseAll result and call Finish even if positions remain.
findings.expected_behavior: Enter persistent CLOSING state and prohibit adds/new entries. Keep original campaign, P/L anchors and protection until broker reconciliation confirms zero owned positions. Retry bounded closes, surface failures, and emit final outcome only after verified closure. Apply to every exit path.
findings.trading_impact: Remaining positions lose campaign metadata/guards and can be reconstructed as a new campaign on next timer. Exit intent is not latched.
findings.fix_specification: Enter persistent CLOSING state and prohibit adds/new entries. Keep original campaign, P/L anchors and protection until broker reconciliation confirms zero owned positions. Retry bounded closes, surface failures, and emit final outcome only after verified closure. Apply to every exit path.
findings.verification: For each exit reason, fail one or all closes across repeated timers/restart; campaign remains CLOSING, no adds, no premature end event.
findings.evidence: Extracted Manage: remainingPositions=1, campaignActive=0, finishCalls=1 after failed master-gone close.

findings.title: Restart loses original stop/recovery state and may adopt wrong campaign state
findings.current_behavior: State file keyed only by magic; firstInitialSLPrice and recoveryExitArmed are not persisted/restored. No-state recovery sets firstEntryPrice and firstSLPrice to zero despite existing master.
findings.root_cause: State file keyed only by magic; firstInitialSLPrice and recoveryExitArmed are not persisted/restored. No-state recovery sets firstEntryPrice and firstSLPrice to zero despite existing master.
findings.expected_behavior: Version and checksum atomic state keyed by account+broker+symbol+magic. Persist original stop, recovery flag, exit latch, earned floor, setup IDs and config snapshot. Reconcile every saved ticket against broker identity. Rebuild actual entry/SL from positions; mark unknown historical anchors explicitly and block additions until reconciliation.
findings.trading_impact: Recovery-to-entry protection stops after restart. Shared magic across symbols/accounts can collide; state loss changes exits and profit anchors.
findings.fix_specification: Version and checksum atomic state keyed by account+broker+symbol+magic. Persist original stop, recovery flag, exit latch, earned floor, setup IDs and config snapshot. Reconcile every saved ticket against broker identity. Rebuild actual entry/SL from positions; mark unknown historical anchors explicitly and block additions until reconciliation.
findings.verification: Restart before/after recovery arm and BE; missing/truncated file; two symbols/accounts using same magic; verify identical safe management or explicit recovery-only mode.

findings.title: Several dashboard risk controls do not affect the EA
findings.current_behavior: NORMAL margin ladder, fixed SL, break-even and recovery settings are accepted/stored by server and shown in UI, but EA continues reading local Inp values. TP and ratchet ARE wired at audited HEAD.
findings.root_cause: NORMAL margin ladder, fixed SL, break-even and recovery settings are accepted/stored by server and shown in UI, but EA continues reading local Inp values. TP and ratchet ARE wired at audited HEAD.
findings.expected_behavior: Add typed Config fields and load/cache them consistently, or remove remote controls and label local-only. Define one source-of-truth precedence and report applied value/hash per field. Version the protocol and build. Preserve existing behavior until explicitly migrated.
findings.trading_impact: User believes protection/sizing changed when executable behavior did not. Same 3.7.1 version string covers revisions before and after TP/ratchet fix.
findings.fix_specification: Add typed Config fields and load/cache them consistently, or remove remote controls and label local-only. Define one source-of-truth precedence and report applied value/hash per field. Version the protocol and build. Preserve existing behavior until explicitly migrated.
findings.verification: Change each setting independently via actual canonical route, assert runtime sizing/exit behavior changes, not merely JSON round-trip; reload offline and verify same applied values.

findings.title: Earned ratchet floor can decrease after settings change
findings.current_behavior: Protected floor is recomputed from current settings each scan; stored floorProfitPct is not used to enforce monotonicity.
findings.root_cause: Protected floor is recomputed from current settings each scan; stored floorProfitPct is not used to enforce monotonicity.
findings.expected_behavior: Snapshot campaign protection policy or implement tighten-only live updates. Persist earned floor=max(previous,newlyEarnedFloor); explicit protection removal must have separate semantics. Validate lock<=trigger and compatible step progression unless immediate-close behavior is intentionally specified.
findings.trading_impact: A previously earned floor can vanish or shrink without closing. Disabling ratchet mid-campaign also removes it.
findings.fix_specification: Snapshot campaign protection policy or implement tighten-only live updates. Persist earned floor=max(previous,newlyEarnedFloor); explicit protection removal must have separate semantics. Validate lock<=trigger and compatible step progression unless immediate-close behavior is intentionally specified.
findings.verification: Earn +100 floor, reduce config lock to20 then P/L50: retained floor must trigger closure. Restart/config rollback must not lower it.
findings.evidence: Extracted Manage retained position at profit50 after config lowered previously earned100 floor to20.

findings.title: Margin allocation is not a basket loss budget; account mode unguarded
findings.current_behavior: Defaults permit unlimited layer count and NORMAL L3+ consumes up to100% available margin. Only master gets broker SL; no margin-level reserve, total-volume cap or netting/hedging guard.
findings.root_cause: Defaults permit unlimited layer count and NORMAL L3+ consumes up to100% available margin. Only master gets broker SL; no margin-level reserve, total-volume cap or netting/hedging guard.
findings.expected_behavior: Add broker account-mode preflight; initially refuse unsupported netting. Specify max basket loss at structural stop, max lots/layers and margin reserve independently of margin allocation. Model all layers at common adverse exits and gaps. Do not copy video leverage as an entry improvement.
findings.trading_impact: Additional positions rely on terminal-driven basket exits, which can be delayed/offline. On netting accounts one pooled position breaks assumptions about a separate master and layers.
findings.fix_specification: Add broker account-mode preflight; initially refuse unsupported netting. Specify max basket loss at structural stop, max lots/layers and margin reserve independently of margin allocation. Model all layers at common adverse exits and gaps. Do not copy video leverage as an entry improvement.
findings.verification: Hedging/netting demos; increasing free-margin pyramid followed by reversal/disconnection; verify exposure caps and broker protection. Chosen numeric risk limits require owner policy, not optimization on seven videos.

findings.title: Heartbeat denial bypasses the config denial handling
findings.current_behavior: Heartbeat failure returns before GET config; any HTTP status including explicit403 is treated as transport failure. Config denial disarms but does not invalidate stored VALID/ARM cache.
findings.root_cause: Heartbeat failure returns before GET config; any HTTP status including explicit403 is treated as transport failure. Config denial disarms but does not invalidate stored VALID/ARM cache.
findings.expected_behavior: Parse authenticated structured denial consistently on heartbeat and config, persist a denial tombstone and disarm new exposure while continuing exits. Preserve last-good config only for transient transport/server failures. Malformed200 is a protocol error, not automatically an explicit license denial.
findings.trading_impact: A revoked/account-mismatched license can retain cached arm state; restart can reload previously armed cache after a denial.
findings.fix_specification: Parse authenticated structured denial consistently on heartbeat and config, persist a denial tombstone and disarm new exposure while continuing exits. Preserve last-good config only for transient transport/server failures. Malformed200 is a protocol error, not automatically an explicit license denial.
findings.verification: Active cached session→canonical403 on heartbeat; restart offline must remain denied. Network500/timeout must preserve approved offline behavior; malformed200 must log protocol failure without pretending authenticated denial.

findings.title: Cache and revision handling can revert execution behavior
findings.current_behavior: String fields such as profile and targetMode are not cached; older config revision is applied before revision comparison. Parser is substring-based, not structural JSON.
findings.root_cause: String fields such as profile and targetMode are not cached; older config revision is applied before revision comparison. Parser is substring-based, not structural JSON.
findings.expected_behavior: Persist complete versioned config atomically with account/license identity and revision. Reject lower revision before apply; validate strict typed JSON envelope and mandatory fields, then swap config atomically. Define explicit offline lease behavior without silently adding a new timeout policy.
findings.trading_impact: Offline restart can turn UNLIMITED/EQUITY configuration into defaults; stale replies can roll back arm or risk settings.
findings.fix_specification: Persist complete versioned config atomically with account/license identity and revision. Reject lower revision before apply; validate strict typed JSON envelope and mandatory fields, then swap config atomically. Define explicit offline lease behavior without silently adding a new timeout policy.
findings.verification: Round-trip every field including strings; old revision after newer disarm; whitespace/nested/escaped/malformed JSON; missing mandatory fields leave last-good config unchanged.

findings.title: Canonical events and acknowledgements do not reach dashboard state
findings.current_behavior: Current EA emits canonical Mongo events; buildMe reads only local events.ndjson and local ack fields, ignores remote.recentEvents and always returns campaign:null.
findings.root_cause: Current EA emits canonical Mongo events; buildMe reads only local events.ndjson and local ack fields, ignores remote.recentEvents and always returns campaign:null.
findings.expected_behavior: Use canonical paginated event stream with stable IDs and durable consumer checkpoint. Project campaign/acks from reconciled events; do not rely on latest60 events for full history. Render desired arm, applied arm, revision/hash and stale/unknown distinctly.
findings.trading_impact: Connected dashboard can show no campaign/history and an unacknowledged command despite active trading. Diagnostics cannot establish actual execution.
findings.fix_specification: Use canonical paginated event stream with stable IDs and durable consumer checkpoint. Project campaign/acks from reconciled events; do not rely on latest60 events for full history. Render desired arm, applied arm, revision/hash and stale/unknown distinctly.
findings.verification: Canonical start/layer/ack/end events with no legacy calls must populate active campaign, history and ACK exactly once; reconnect/replay must not duplicate.
findings.evidence: Actual server fake-bridge test: CONNECTED with 2 remote events, campaign null, history empty, ack revision0.

findings.title: Heartbeat connectivity and financial fields are incomplete
findings.current_behavior: EA hardcodes connection flags, omits free margin/open positions/actual campaign/applied revision. History lacks realized P/L, final equity and several UI fields; basket P/L excludes commission and realized partial closes.
findings.root_cause: EA hardcodes connection flags, omits free margin/open positions/actual campaign/applied revision. History lacks realized P/L, final equity and several UI fields; basket P/L excludes commission and realized partial closes.
findings.expected_behavior: Emit actual terminal/account/quote readiness, owned positions, margin, executable config hash and scan gate. Reconcile deal history including commissions/swaps/partials and external flows; keep floating and realized measures separate. Emit per-fill price/time and sampled quote paths for MAE/MFE.
findings.trading_impact: Connected is transport recency, not proof of broker trading readiness. Cannot calculate reliable entry quality or campaign outcomes from current telemetry.
findings.fix_specification: Emit actual terminal/account/quote readiness, owned positions, margin, executable config hash and scan gate. Reconcile deal history including commissions/swaps/partials and external flows; keep floating and realized measures separate. Emit per-fill price/time and sampled quote paths for MAE/MFE.
findings.verification: Terminal disconnected but internet active; partial close, commission, deposit and manual intervention; reconstructed net campaign P/L matches broker statement. Missing values display unknown, never zero success.

findings.title: Config accepts unknown protocol fields and unsafe type combinations
findings.current_behavior: clean spreads unknown keys and coerces Boolean("false") to true. Bridge spreads cfg after protected response fields. Ratchet lock can exceed trigger.
findings.root_cause: clean spreads unknown keys and coerces Boolean("false") to true. Bridge spreads cfg after protected response fields. Ratchet lock can exceed trigger.
findings.expected_behavior: Use strict allowlisted schema, reject unknown keys and nonboolean types, validate cross-field constraints. Keep licenseStatus/revision/identity outside config namespace; construct protected envelope after validated config. Apply same schema in both services and EA.
findings.trading_impact: Malformed or crafted client settings can alter protocol metadata or arm unexpectedly; invalid combinations have surprising execution. This is not an unauthenticated exploit claim.
findings.fix_specification: Use strict allowlisted schema, reject unknown keys and nonboolean types, validate cross-field constraints. Keep licenseStatus/revision/identity outside config namespace; construct protected envelope after validated config. Apply same schema in both services and EA.
findings.verification: Reject string false, unknown licenseStatus/commandRevision, lock>trigger and invalid profile. Server-derived envelope fields cannot be overwritten.
findings.evidence: Actual clean test retained licenseStatus, armed on string false and accepted trigger100/lock500.

findings.title: Concurrent config writes lack revision and storage transaction safety
findings.current_behavior: Unlocked read-modify-write, timestamp temp names, remote sync before local commit; bridge accepts unconditional revisions. Read failure silently becomes defaults/empty object.
findings.root_cause: Unlocked read-modify-write, timestamp temp names, remote sync before local commit; bridge accepts unconditional revisions. Read failure silently becomes defaults/empty object.
findings.expected_behavior: Use transactional storage with optimistic expectedRevision, unique temp files if files remain, durable outbox for remote delivery and idempotency key. Bridge rejects older revisions. Distinguish missing file from corrupt/unreadable data; fail visibly while retaining recoverable last-good state.
findings.trading_impact: Concurrent tabs/admin requests can lose settings or regress revision; remote/local can disagree after partial failure. Corruption may erase apparent licenses/config.
findings.fix_specification: Use transactional storage with optimistic expectedRevision, unique temp files if files remain, durable outbox for remote delivery and idempotency key. Bridge rejects older revisions. Distinguish missing file from corrupt/unreadable data; fail visibly while retaining recoverable last-good state.
findings.verification: Concurrent nonoverlapping updates, same-ms writes, process kill between remote/local commit, disk full and corrupt JSON; no lost acknowledged update or silent fallback.
findings.evidence: Source-established race/partial-write windows; concurrency fault injection not executed in this audit.

findings.title: Remote bridge can block startup and HTTP requests indefinitely
findings.current_behavior: fetch has no explicit timeout; all startup license synchronization precedes listen.
findings.root_cause: fetch has no explicit timeout; all startup license synchronization precedes listen.
findings.expected_behavior: Start local read/status service independently of bridge reconciliation. Add bounded request deadlines, circuit breaker and durable retries. Expose pending synchronization and never report applied success before confirmation.
findings.trading_impact: An unavailable bridge can prevent dashboard startup; a config save or status poll can hang.
findings.fix_specification: Start local read/status service independently of bridge reconciliation. Add bounded request deadlines, circuit breaker and durable retries. Expose pending synchronization and never report applied success before confirmation.
findings.verification: Black-hole bridge during startup/status/save: server remains locally available and returns explicit bounded pending/error status. Existing EA risk management remains independent.

findings.title: Canonical expiry and blank-account semantics differ from local service
findings.current_behavior: Canonical resolver checks is_active and binding but not expires_at. Local service checks expiry; blank local account accepts multiple accounts whereas canonical first-claim binds.
findings.root_cause: Canonical resolver checks is_active and binding but not expires_at. Local service checks expiry; blank local account accepts multiple accounts whereas canonical first-claim binds.
findings.expected_behavior: Enforce expiry and nonempty authenticated account centrally on every EA request using canonical server time. Share one binding policy with legacy endpoints or retire them. Ensure admin updates preserve atomic first-claim semantics and distinguish expiry from outages.
findings.trading_impact: Expiry need not take effect at expiry time without a subsequent synchronization; different endpoints can disagree on entitlement/account.
findings.fix_specification: Enforce expiry and nonempty authenticated account centrally on every EA request using canonical server time. Share one binding policy with legacy endpoints or retire them. Ensure admin updates preserve atomic first-claim semantics and distinguish expiry from outages.
findings.verification: License crosses expiry without restart/sync; both paths deny new exposure. Two account first-claim race has one winner; legacy route cannot bypass binding.
findings.evidence: Confirmed in pinned local XauCloud counterpart only; deployed counterpart revision and any external expiry scheduler are unverified.

findings.title: License profile and execution profile disagree
findings.current_behavior: Admin stores UNLIMITED label on license but synchronizes default NORMAL config unless separately saved.
findings.root_cause: Admin stores UNLIMITED label on license but synchronizes default NORMAL config unless separately saved.
findings.expected_behavior: Write profile into authoritative per-license execution config transactionally and bump revision, or separate commercial license tier from execution profile with explicit naming. Show applied execution profile independently.
findings.trading_impact: User/admin sees a profile different from actual sizing and exits.
findings.fix_specification: Write profile into authoritative per-license execution config transactionally and bump revision, or separate commercial license tier from execution profile with explicit naming. Show applied execution profile independently.
findings.verification: Create UNLIMITED license and poll config/dashboard: all execution fields agree or clearly show distinct tier/profile.
findings.evidence: Actual server test: licenseProfile UNLIMITED, executionConfigProfile NORMAL.

findings.title: Known fallback secrets are accepted at startup
findings.current_behavior: ADMIN_TOKEN and SESSION_SECRET fall back to public fixed strings; service has no dedicated User configured.
findings.root_cause: ADMIN_TOKEN and SESSION_SECRET fall back to public fixed strings; service has no dedicated User configured.
findings.expected_behavior: Refuse production startup for absent/default/weak secrets. Provision random secrets outside source, rotate existing defaults if used, add dedicated least-privilege service user and writable data directory; keep session cookie security attributes.
findings.trading_impact: If deployed without secure overrides, admin/session authority uses known secrets and service runs with service-manager default privileges. Live deployment configuration was not inspected.
findings.fix_specification: Refuse production startup for absent/default/weak secrets. Provision random secrets outside source, rotate existing defaults if used, add dedicated least-privilege service user and writable data directory; keep session cookie security attributes.
findings.verification: Production without valid secrets fails before listening; valid configuration passes; service cannot write source/system paths. Do not print real credentials.

findings.title: Setup instructions point to the wrong WebRequest origin
findings.current_behavior: UI/README say allow apex.xaucloud.io; EA default calls xaucloud.io. Health says3.7.0 while source says3.7.1; no current compiled EX5/build provenance in repository.
findings.root_cause: UI/README say allow apex.xaucloud.io; EA default calls xaucloud.io. Health says3.7.0 while source says3.7.1; no current compiled EX5/build provenance in repository.

findings.title: Learning display is observational; no strategy adaptation exists
findings.current_behavior: Backend returns zero adjustments and OBSERVATION_ONLY; no trained model or performance feedback modifies entries.
findings.root_cause: Backend returns zero adjustments and OBSERVATION_ONLY; no trained model or performance feedback modifies entries.
findings.expected_behavior: Label feature accurately and retain zero live adjustments. First collect audited entry/rejection/fill/outcome data; implement offline labeled evaluation before any bounded, versioned, rollback-capable adaptation. Remove/deactivate unused learning controls if no implementation is intended.
findings.trading_impact: Enabling learning does not make Apex progressively think like the trader. Current telemetry is insufficient for reliable adaptation anyway.
findings.fix_specification: Label feature accurately and retain zero live adjustments. First collect audited entry/rejection/fill/outcome data; implement offline labeled evaluation before any bounded, versioned, rollback-capable adaptation. Remove/deactivate unused learning controls if no implementation is intended.
findings.verification: UI explains observation-only status; nonzero adjustments require an explicitly approved/versioned model and out-of-sample acceptance tests.

findings.title: Same magic allows competing EA instances to manage the same basket
findings.current_behavior: Ownership is account terminal positions filtered only by symbol and magic, without a single-writer lock or instance identity.
findings.root_cause: Ownership is account terminal positions filtered only by symbol and magic, without a single-writer lock or instance identity.
findings.expected_behavior: Enforce one active manager per account+symbol+magic with terminal-level lock/lease and explicit takeover reconciliation. Persist unique campaign IDs with sufficient entropy; do not derive uniqueness only from seconds.
findings.trading_impact: Two charts on the same symbol/magic can submit duplicate entries, overwrite state and issue competing exits.
findings.fix_specification: Enforce one active manager per account+symbol+magic with terminal-level lock/lease and explicit takeover reconciliation. Persist unique campaign IDs with sufficient entropy; do not derive uniqueness only from seconds.
findings.verification: Attach two instances simultaneously; one becomes observer-only. Crash/takeover preserves open campaign and never duplicates an order.

findings.title: Live settings can change campaign policy inconsistently
findings.current_behavior: targetEq is frozen at campaign start while profile and most ratchet/entry settings change immediately. Changing profile toggles master/BE/recovery protections mid-campaign.
findings.root_cause: targetEq is frozen at campaign start while profile and most ratchet/entry settings change immediately. Changing profile toggles master/BE/recovery protections mid-campaign.
findings.expected_behavior: Version/snapshot campaign policy. Define next-campaign settings and allowable tighten-only live protection changes. Report desired, applied and effective-from fields; reject dangerous mid-campaign profile changes.
findings.trading_impact: A TP save may apply only next campaign while profile change immediately removes protection; UI does not communicate this distinction.
findings.fix_specification: Version/snapshot campaign policy. Define next-campaign settings and allowable tighten-only live protection changes. Report desired, applied and effective-from fields; reject dangerous mid-campaign profile changes.
findings.verification: Change TP, profile and ratchet during an open basket; behavior matches explicit timing, preserved protections and displayed applied policy.
